caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright, rectangular brown glass bottle with rounded shoulders and a short, cylindrical neck opening at the top. The bottle is centrally placed on a plain, light beige or off-white background with no other objects present. Embossed on the front of the bottle is a decorative motif that appears to be a bundle of wheat tied together with a ribbon, with a sickle and a rake crossed behind it. The brown color of the bottle exhibits areas of lighter and darker shades, suggesting reflections and transparency of glass. The surface of the bottle also shows some subtle texture and highlights indicating its glossy finish. The artist's signature "Alf Brusetth" is visible in small letters at the lower right portion of the drawing.
title: Whiskey Flask
